scheme_name: Financial Assistance of Hearing Machine/Hearing Aid to Workers and their Dependents- Haryana Labour Welfare Board
other_conditions: Must be employed in an industrial or commercial establishment in Haryana
Must be registered with the Haryana Labour Welfare Board
Service period of the worker is fixed for one year
Benefit is available after every five years of service
Eligibility requires loss of hearing due to an accident or any other reason
Registration may require Parivar Pehchan Patra (Family ID) or Aadhaar Number
benefits_summary: Provides a one-time financial assistance up to ₹5,000 (or the actual cost if lower) for the purchase of a hearing aid, available to workers and their dependents every five years.
